text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, April 29 - Chittagong - 23 Vessels in port of which 5 containers, 3 general cargo, 4 repairs, 5 cement, 2 tankers, 1 cement clinker, 1 rock phosphate, 2 fertiliser. 26 Vessels due by 6/5 of which 12 containers, 5 general cargo, 3 foodgrain, 3 repairs, 1 cement, 2 tankers. No delays.

INDIA, April 30 - Bombay - Delays for vessels, containers, general cargo 1-2 days, bulk 4-5 days. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 20 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 7 waiting to discharge. 1 Vessel bunkering, 3 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Gang shortage due to holidays. Calcutta - 27 Vessels due (3 coking coal, 10 product tankers, 5 containers, 2 general, 2 crude, 3 coal, 1 timber, 1 steel plates). 7 Vessels loading at berth, 19 discharging, 2 bunkering. Cochin - Five due, 1-2 days delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging. 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 General cargo at CSL jetty, 1 naval vessel at drydock.

Chennai (Madras) - 36 Vessels due of which 6 coal, 2 iron ore, 2 fertiliser, 5 general, 4 edible oil, 12 containers, 1 phosphoric acid, 2 barytes, 1 pax, 1 logs. Delays, coal/coke, fertiliser, others 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Mormugao - Vessels due, 7 ores (4-5 days delay), 1 naphtha, 1 mop, 1 phosphoric acid, 1 coke. 2 Vessels loading at berth. 6 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at berth. 2 waiting to load. 2 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders.

Kandla - 21 Vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 5 discharging at berth, 4 waiting to discharge, 4 arrested in harbour, 4 tankers, 28 waiting. Mangalore - Eight vessels due, up to 1 days delay expected. 4 Loading/discharging at berth, 3 awaiting berth, 1 arrested. Jawaharlal Nehru - Three foodgrain vessels due, 10 days berthing delay. 2 Tankers due, 5 days delay. 3 Vessels discharging at berth, 2 at anchorage to discharge. Holiday 1/5. Paradip - Nine vessels due, 2-3 days delay expected. 3 Vessels loading, 1 discharging, 3 waiting at anchorage to load. Tuticorin - Four vessels due, 1-2 days delay. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging, 1 discharging at anchorage, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 under repair/drydock. Visakhapatnam - 23 Due, 7-8 days delay expected. 5 Vessels loading at berth. 6 discharging. 2 Waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 2 waiting to load.

MALAYSIA, April 30 - Port Keelang - North/south port container/ro-ro berth - 8 Vessels alongside, 4 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Alongside, 2 berthed, 4 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 4 Alongside, 1 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 2 Alongside, 1 waiting. West port container/ro-ro berth - 2 Alongside. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 Alongside, 5 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Bulk cement terminal - 2 Alongside, 1 waiting. Liquid bulk - 1 Alongside.

MAURITIUS, April 29 - Port Louis - One container vessel alongside to discharge/load, 2 general cargo for discharging. Fishing port - 6 Vessels discharging and bunkering. No idle vessels. Port operations very slow due to heavy rain. Bunching of vessels expected 1/5-3/5, berthing delays foreseen. Public holiday 1/5, no work in port.

PHILIPPINES, April 29 - Manila - Eight vessels discharging at berth, 8 discharging at anchorage, 5 waiting at outside anchorage to discharge. 21 Other vessels in port. Average waiting time for vessels with a draft less than 8 metres and loa less than 130 metres 1 day. Draft greater than 9 metres and loa more than 140 metres 1-2 days. Isabel, Leyte (Pasar wharf) - 2 Vessels in port, 1 due 3/5. Iligan (NSC pier) - 1 Vessel in port.

SOUTH KOREA, April 29 - Inchon - 55 Vessels in port (37 berthed, 18 anchored) of which 9 general cargo, 5 each logs, steel, 4 containers, 3 cars, 3 each soybean, wheat, raw sugar, cottonseed meal, bananas, soymeal, h-beam, coils, corn, ply, pig iron. Anchored, 3 each logs, containers, 2 each general cargo, steel pulp, 1 each talc, corn, silica sand, 1 days delay. Busan - 163 In port (48 berthed, 115 anchored including 58 laid up), 33 general cargo, 7 containers, 4 each scrap, coal. 57 Waiting, 2 days delay.

Pohang - 22 In port (20 berthed, 2 anchored) of which discharging 4 billets, 3 each pipes, coils, 2 scrap, 1 each iron ore, steel, flint clay, plates. 4 Loading steel, 2 waiting, 1-2 days delay. Ulsan - 21 Berthed of which discharging, 2 woodchips, 2 crude oil, 1 each coal, feed meal, cement, fertiliser, logs, soda ash, zinc concentrates, chemical, corn. Loading, 4 resin, 2 steel pipes, 1 each caustic soda, molten sulphur, no delays. Masan - Six vessels berthed. Discharging, 3 scrap, 1 tapioca. Loading, 1 steel coils, 1 container, no delays.

SIERRA LEONE, April 29 - Freetown - Vessels due, 1 tanker for discharging refined products, 3 containers for discharging/loading, 1 container/vehicles discharger, 1 pipes discharger. No delays expected. 1 Aid cargo discharging/loading at berth.

SINGAPORE, April 29 - Singapore - Tanjg Pagar container terminal - 9 Container vessels berthed. Keppel - 8 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang - 9 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang - 1 General cargo vessel berthed. Jurong port - 1 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessel berthed. Oil terminal/sbm buoys - 15 Tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays at all facilities.

SRI LANKA, April 29 - Colombo - Vessels due, 11 containers, 1 bulk maize. Delays 6-7 days for breakbulk vessels, 24 hours for container vessels. Loading at berth, 10 containers, 3 essential services. Discharging at berth, 10 containers, 1 bagged fertiliser, 5 bagged sugar, general cargo. 1 container vessel waiting at anchorage to load. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 container, 4 bagged sugar, 1 bagged rice, 1 onion. 3 Vessels bunkering, 2 under repair, 1 in drydock, 6 awaiting orders. Galle - No vessels. Trincomalee - Two vessels discharging at berth.

TAIWAN, April 28 - Keelung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 6 days, steel 4 days, iron ore 3 days. Kaohsiung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain/steel 1 day, iron/coal 2 days, coal/scrap (public berth) 3 days. Taichung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 5-6 days, iron ore, coal, scrap, steel 1 day, others 1-2 days. Keelung - Vessels in port, 12 containers, 1 tanker, 6 other bulkers, 4 general cargo. Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, 1 container, 1 bulker. Average berthing delay, containers 10 hours, other bulkers 1 day.
THAILAND, April 25 - Bangkok - 96 Vessels in port of which 6 containers, 1 tanker, 89 other bulkers and general cargo vessels. 3 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, 1-2 days berthing delay expected.
